description: Telecommiunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka - Radio and Telecommiunications Terminal Equipment (RTTE) Type approval Rules - 2020
reasoning: This gazette contains rules and regulations made by the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Telecommunications Act. It establishes a comprehensive regulatory framework for radio and telecommunications terminal equipment type approval, including application procedures, standards, fees, and importation requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it creates new regulatory rules and compliance requirements.
